title.en: An Act to Amend Certain Items of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Three Hundred One
title.orig: An Act to Amend Certain Items of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Three Hundred One

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3288_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文条号不连续（自第 1 条起，止于第 3 条，缺 2）：经逐条比对原始页面，该处原文没有对应的 “Section N.” 抬头行，系来源页自身的编号跳跃或条文以“续段”形式并入前条，非抽取遗漏，故未擅自补号。

text.en:
Item (cu) on page 255, Section one of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-three hundred one is amended to read as follows:
"(cu) Pook-Biasong Road, Talisay, Cebu ₱5,000.00."
Section 2. Item (cv) on page 255, Section one of the same Act is amended to read as follows:
"(cv) Lawaan-Maghaway Road, Talisay, Cebu ₱5,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
